scope.description: Finite signed-spin Kerr-equation consistency check with author-seeded direct roots.
known_limitations: The strict direct solver belongs to the same native Kerr implementation family used to generate the spline; this is an equation-consistency check, not a fully independent physical oracle.
Cook author data only seed the branch solve and are not generator inputs, copied assets, or comparison answers.
The finite declared points cannot prove a continuous-domain maximum or qualify historical SEOBNRv4 table compatibility, attached waveforms, or the ROM.
